notes.raw: * ''Wuju Style'' can be cast during ''[[File:Master Yi Alpha Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Master Yi#Alpha Strike|An icon for Master Yi's ability Alpha Strike]] [[Master Yi#Alpha Strike|Alpha Strike]]''. * ''Wuju Style'' cannot be cast while it is already active. * ''Wuju Style's'' bonus true damage does not interact with [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strikes]]. * ''Wuju Style's'' bonus true damage cannot be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] but can be [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]] and/or missed if '''Master Yi''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against [[structures]]. * While ''Wuju Style'' is active, the damage will dynamically update its calculations.
notes.text:
Wuju Style can be cast during Alpha Strike.
Wuju Style cannot be cast while it is already active.
Wuju Style's bonus true damage does not interact with critical strikes.
Wuju Style's bonus true damage cannot be blocked but can be dodged and/or missed if Master Yi is blinded.
The attacks do not deal the bonus damage against structures.
While Wuju Style is active, the damage will dynamically update its calculations.
